contract: Volatile bounded per-sender sequence-window duplicate and stale-input suppression; positive construction-time window/max_senders; refuse new senders at capacity without eviction. Accepted inputs emit unchanged. Proofs cover supplied-decision step laws and singleton_advance_window (helper/W=1 only), not receiver or general window bounds; those have finite test/model evidence.
limits: State loss permits duplicates; no durability, clock, time expiry, acknowledgement policy or exactly-once Effects.
Suppression includes unseen stale inputs and lower incarnations; no cross-sender ordering or reordering buffer.
Selected step laws assume supplied decisions; classify/receiver and general W > 1 bounds have finite test/model evidence, not proofs.
singleton_advance_window is a helper/W=1 law only; it does not prove flag selection, helper storage in step, other-sender preservation or a whole-receiver/window invariant.
Entry counts, not bytes, are bounded. Direct erased callers must supply well-formed values.

duplicate_keeps_state: selected step-with-supplied-decision law only, not classify or receiver.

stale_keeps_state: selected step-with-supplied-decision law only, not classify or receiver.

full_keeps_state: selected step-with-supplied-decision law only, not classify or receiver.
reorder_preserves_message: selected step-with-supplied-decision law only, not classify or receiver.
advance_preserves_message: selected step-with-supplied-decision law only, not classify or receiver.
Helper/W=1 law only: advance_accepted(True(), window, sequence, previous) equals singleton(sequence); no receiver or general window-bound proof.
Pinned Cure checks production source and typed composition; tests reject false output law, production singleton mutation by conversion_failure, and unfinished hole.
Finite boundary, capacity, incarnation, retention/helper agreement, seeded independent model, composition and clean audit scenarios; not universal proofs.
Validating Elixir boundary exercised by the in-bundle tests, including improper lists and construction-time configuration.
Relies on pinned Elixir/OTP integer, list and BEAM semantics.
Senders assign increasing sequences per incarnation and strictly increase incarnation on restart; volatile state retained by caller. No clock or durable storage supplied.

telemetry.contract: Pure callable without lifecycle; invoking Unit/Assembly owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Positive integer window and max_senders validated by new/2 and fixed in state at construction; no hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: No runtime lifecycle to pause, drain or resume.
